goal: Project skeleton: pyproject.toml, a contextos/ package, a Typer command `contextos` with --version, a tests/ folder, and CI that runs the tests.
Context format: a Pydantic model for one saved context (title, summary, decisions, open questions, next steps, key facts, files, code, source tool, created time) and a Markdown renderer.
Local storage: save, list, search, load and delete contexts in one SQLite file under CONTEXTOS_HOME (default ~/.contextos).
Secret hiding: replace API keys, private keys, passwords in URLs, emails and phone numbers with markers like [hidden: email] before a context is saved; keep only counts.
MCP server `contextos mcp` with tools save_context, list_contexts, search_contexts, load_context, using the store and secret hiding.
Tool instructions: the MCP tool descriptions tell the calling agent how to write a good context and to save only when the user asks.
README: what ContextOS does, setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor, and a demo of chat A saving and chat B loading.
Command-line helpers: contextos list, show <id>, delete <id>.
